## Error details
If an error is raised, it is very important that you provide the full error message.
Otherwise we won't be able to help you much with your problem.

## Environment
Please provide the following information:
* **Operating System**: Windows, Mac OSX, Linux flavour...
* **`pico8-l10n` version used**: run `pico8-l10n --version` to check it
* **pico-8 version**: you have the command installed on your compiter. It can be seen at the top of the `pico-8_manual.txt` file
